original_question: Zaid yana kashe kaso 1/4 na albashinsa a haya, 1/3 akan man mota sannan yana bayar da rabin sauran kudin da ya rage sadaka. Yakan bai wa diyarsa $200 don yin amfani dasu wajen biyan bukatun ta na mako-mako da kuma $700 ga matarsa don yin kasafin kudin cefane da sauran kayayyakin gida. Idan Zaid yana samun 6000$ a kowane wata, nawa zai samu bayan wannan kashe-kashen kudin da gudummawar?
question_template: {name_male, Zaid} yana kashe kaso {num_frac_1, 1/4} na albashinsa a haya, {num_frac_2, 1/3} akan man mota sannan yana bayar da {num_frac_3, rabin} sauran kudin da ya rage sadaka. Yakan bai wa diyarsa ${num_digit_1, 200} don yin amfani dasu wajen biyan bukatun ta na mako-mako da kuma ${num_digit_2, 700} ga matarsa don yin kasafin kudin cefane da sauran kayayyakin gida. Idan {name_male, Zaid} yana samun ${num_digit_3, 6000} a kowane wata, nawa zai samu bayan wannan kashe-kashen kudin da gudummawar?
